for diabetic macular edema (DME), adding a new clinical catalyst for investors.
FDMT stock traded at nearly $14.40, down nearly 10% over the past week. However, despite the recent weakness, the stock remained up about 92% year to date.
The company said the first patients had been enrolled in its global 4SIGHT Phase 3 trial, which will test 4D-150 against aflibercept in 514 patients with DME.

The move was backed by 2-year data from the earlier SPECTRA trial. At the Phase 3 dose, patients recorded a 10.8-letter improvement in vision and a 176-micron reduction in retinal thickness. Two of nine patients also remained injection-free.
Importantly, 4D-150 reduced the treatment burden, with patients requiring 61% fewer supplemental injections than the projected number under standard aflibercept treatment.
“The initiation of 4SIGHT marks an important step” toward developing 4D-150 as a longer-lasting treatment for major retinal diseases, CEO David Kirn said.

title: 4DMT Molecular enters phase 3 trial of 4D-150 for diabetic eye disease
